units.text: {drop}Drop a pinch of salt into water, and it seems to vanish.
The crystals sink, and in a minute or so they are {gone}gone. [pause] Nothing has disappeared, though. The salt has only come apart.
A salt crystal is a stack of {ions}sodium and chloride ions. Water molecules crowd its edges, {pull}pull the ions loose one by one, and {shell}carry each away in a shell of water.
Nothing vanished. It came apart, one ion at a time.
